doors.note:
Configured parser URL. WordPress (WPBakery + Slider Revolution 6.7.57, Offbeat theme 1.8 with its offbeat-event post type). Each card: , a poster , with day/month/weekday spans,

and an optional

tagline. The 18 datetime values run 2026-09-02 … 2026-09-26 and match the 18 event pages exactly. The page is a calendar of the CURRENT month, not an upcoming filter: 13 of the 18 dates are before the recon date. Read from the cached copy fetched 2026-09-19 (scratchpad probe/bars/akbar-events.html, 105,456 chars).

All 18 slugs the listing links, cached 2026-09-19 (probe/bars/akbar-events/<slug>.html). Each page: <h2 class="edgtf-page-title"> title with an edgtf-page-subtitle tagline, an offbeat-event-featured-image poster whose alt is "<Title> – <Month D, YYYY> at AKBAR", a "Details" block (Date: <Month D, YYYY>; Duration: 1 Day; sometimes Category: Special Events; Type: open) and a short offbeat-event-content body that carries the start time as prose ("From 10 PM", "Starts at: 9PM"). No JSON-LD, no Open Graph tags, no <time> element, no address, no ticket links. Times, covers and cadence words exist only in that body prose.

Home page (cached 2026-09-19, probe/bars/akbar-la.html), NOT a parser URL — read only for venue facts. Footer: "AKBAR Silverlake 4356 W Sunset Blvd Los Angeles, CA 90029", "Open Daily: 4 PM to 2 AM". A "Coming Up — DJs, Parties & Stuff." section says "Every day is an event at Akbar." and links 4 of the listing's pages as "Special Events:" (sebastiane, the-plastics, laces, crazy-disco-underground); a "Recurring Events:" blurb reads "Tuesdays: Drunk on Stage / Wednesdays: CraftNight" with no dates, times or pages (see traps).

recon.notes: WordPress with the Offbeat theme's event post type (body class offbeat-event-template-default, offbeat-core-1.4 / offbeat-ver-1.8); WPBakery builds the listing. There is no events feed of any kind: no wp-json event route, no ICS, no JSON-LD. The listing is "This Month's EVENTS." — the venue posts one page per party for the current month (a monthly poster PDF twin sits in the archive gallery) and the list is not filtered to upcoming, so on 2026-09-19 it links 13 past pages, 1 page dated today and 4 future pages. Nothing for October 2026 is published anywhere on the site at recon, so the crawl horizon is at most the rest of the current month. Every page states exactly one date; only Broadway Sing-Along states a repeat in text ("Our monthly Showtunes Sing-Along"). Several posters are reused from earlier months (Funk That! from 2025/01, Crazy, Disco Underground from the 2026-02 run), which hints at recurrence but is not a statement of one. Address per the site is "4356 W Sunset Blvd"; defaults use the config spelling without the W.

coverage.basis: Single door: the configured /upcoming-events/ listing (18 akbar-eg-item cards, each with a datetime attribute) cross-checked against all 18 /event/<slug>/ pages it links (each with a "Date:" line) — 18/18 dates agree, zero extra pages, zero pagination. The home page (not a parser URL) links a 4-item "Special Events" subset of the same pages and adds nothing dated. Collapse: 12 pages are dated before 2026-09-19 (Sep 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18) → past-event traps, counted here and enumerated in traps because the crawler reaches every one of them from the listing and allowPastEvents keeps them; 5 pages are dated today or later (The Plastics Sep 19, Planet Queer Sep 21, Funk That! Sep 24, Laces Sep 25, Crazy, Disco Underground Sep 26) and state no repeat → 5 singles; 1 page (Broadway Sing-Along, Sep 14) states "Our monthly Showtunes Sing-Along" → 1 series whose only listed instance is past, materialized in the window by rule (2nd Mondays) with ambiguous confidence. publishedEventCount = 5 + 1 = 6. No page states no date, so there are no recurring-blurb pages among the 18; the home page's "Recurring Events: Tuesdays: Drunk on Stage / Wednesdays: CraftNight" blurb and the 33-PDF poster archive are the non-event traps. Past listings: 12 of the 18 cards on the listing itself, plus the poster-PDF archive back to 2024-01.
knownGaps: The current-month poster PDF (wp-content/uploads/2026/09/AKBAR-Events_2026-09.pdf, linked from the listing's archive gallery) was not read; it may print times or covers the pages omit (e.g. Diva Down and Slash Fiction publish no start time).

Nothing dated October 2026 or later is published at recon; the window's Oct–Dec content is only the rule-derived Broadway Sing-Along dates. The listing is expected to be replaced wholesale on or around Oct 1 (recheckAfter).
Broadway Sing-Along's weekday slot (2nd Monday) is derived from its single listed date, Sep 14 2026; the site says only "monthly".

events.note: The only page of the 18 that states a repeat. The site says "monthly" and gives ONE date, Monday September 14, 2026 (the 2nd Monday) — BYDAY=2MO is derived from that single date, hence ambiguous confidence; the three window occurrences are rule arithmetic, not site listings. The Sep 14 instance itself is past at recon and outside the window, so it is not an occurrence here; the crawler will still extract it from the page as a Sep 14 record (allowPastEvents), which is what expect.extracted refers to. The scraper never writes series (identifier suffix == ICS UID doctrine), so no October–December records are expected from this run. Body: "BROADWAY SING-ALONG / SHOWTUNES KARAOKE / From 8 PM / Our monthly Showtunes Sing-Along, 8PM to Midnight"; midnight end recorded as endTime 00:00 (next day).

traps.why: The second section of the configured listing is a wpmf gallery whose 33 tiles link one poster PDF per month (AKBAR-Events_YYYY-MM.pdf) back to January 2024. They are month posters, not event records; the September 2026 tile duplicates the 18 cards above it. Nothing here should become an event, and the crawler should not follow 33 PDFs.

openQuestions.q: The listing is "This Month's EVENTS." with no next-month view and no October pages at recon (Sep 19). Does the venue publish the next month early (last days of the month) or only on the 1st? A daily crawl in the final week of each month may see 0–4 upcoming events; a run on the 1st should see the whole new month. Worth reading the listing again around Sep 28 and Oct 1.
Broadway Sing-Along says "monthly" and shows one date (Mon Sep 14). Is the slot the 2nd Monday? The October page will settle it; until then the rule-derived occurrences are a hypothesis.
